rows.grounds: qualifies the desired object as diverse
introduces the scope of desired things
denotes what is wished for or intended

items.question: What certainty accompanies the attainment of diverse desired outcomes?
premises: The agent obtains the desired outcome.
The desired outcome may be various in kind.
No doubt exists regarding this attainment.
items.inference: Whatever diverse thing is desired is certainly obtained.
uncertainties: The implicit subject of labhati is not explicitly stated in this verse.
items.plain_english: One indeed obtains whatever various thing is desired; there is no doubt.
